mechanics.claim: The initial cast counts as an ability activation for on-cast effects; the recast does not.
mechanics.quote:
The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}.
** The recast (both manual and automatic) does not.

mechanics.claim: If the target has a spell shield, the whole cast fails and goes on full cooldown without dealing damage or triggering on-cast effects, but the spell shield does not block the recast's damage.
mechanics.quote:
If ''Umbral Trespass'' is targeted on an enemy with a {{tip|spell shield}} or a {{ci|Fiora}} with her {{ai|Riposte|Fiora}} active, the ability will fail to cast entirely, being placed on full cooldown without triggering the active's effects (as well as on-cast effects).
** Spell shield will not block the damage from the recast.

mechanics.claim: If Kayn dies while attached and the recast is available, the damage is dealt immediately; if not available, no damage is dealt at all.
mechanics.quote: If '''Kayn''' dies while {{tip|attached}} and the recast is available, ''Umbral Trespass' '' damage is dealt immediately. If the recast is not available, ''Umbral Trespass' '' damage is not dealt at all.

mechanics.claim: As Rhaast, the heal is granted automatically if the target dies during the channel, but not if the target dies before the channel starts.
mechanics.quote:
As {{ci|Rhaast}}, ''Umbral Trespass'' will grant the {{tip|heal}} automatically if the target dies during the channel.
** The heal is not granted if the target dies before the channel starts.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts after the ability's effect completes (post-effect), not on initial cast.
As Shadow Assassin, emerging from the recast resets The Darkin Scythe's (Q) cooldown.
mechanics.quote: Additionally, emerging will reset ''{{ai|The Darkin Scythe A|Kayn|The Darkin Scythe's}}'' {{sti|cooldown}}.

mechanics.claim: Damage from the recast is not blocked even if the target is untargetable at the time of the recast.
mechanics.quote: The damage is '''not''' blocked if the target is {{tip|untargetable}} at the time of the recast.
